belarus.title: Flag of the Republic of Belarus

colors.note: Represents the past — sacrifice, courage, and the country's historical struggles.
Symbolises hope, renewal, and Belarusian forests and farmland.
The hoist ornament in red on white depicts traditional Belarusian rushnik embroidery.

desc:
- Two horizontal bands of red (top, two-thirds) and green (bottom, one-third)
- A vertical red-on-white decorative pattern runs along the hoist, derived from traditional rushnik embroidery
- Adopted by referendum on 14 May 1995, modelled on the Byelorussian SSR flag minus Soviet emblems
trivia:
- The ornament pattern originated on a 1917 rushnik (ritual cloth) woven by Matrona Markevich
- The 1995 design replaced the white-red-white flag used 1991-1995 after restoring independence
- In 2012 the original hammer-and-sickle-free ornament was slightly redrawn by presidential decree
